documents.text: Aurora Research Center operates from Port Willow. The center opens at 08:30 each weekday. The director is Dr Lina Moore. Visitors must register with the reception desk. The annual audit occurs each September.

Meridian Testing Laboratory is located in Cedar Point. Its lead scientist is Kenji Vale. The primary instrument is a quartz spectrometer. Calibration is performed every fourteen days. Safety training takes place each February.

Cobalt Cooperative runs a bicycle sharing program. Its fleet contains 240 bicycles. Membership renewals occur in March. The equipment warehouse is in East Haven. Customer support is available Monday through Saturday.

Summit Ecology Project studies river insects. Its field station is at Moss Valley. Samples are stored for thirty days. Field technicians wear orange identification badges. The next survey is scheduled for October.

Solstice Archive preserves historical photographs. The collection has 12000 photographs. The cataloging system is called Lantern. Backups are performed every Sunday. Public exhibitions are held at North Quay Gallery.
